name: Youtube
description: Patched version of Youtube provided by Morphe-AutoBuilds.
author: Morphe-AutoBuilds
modInfo: Hide Ads: Removes home feed, search feed, and video player advertisements.
SponsorBlock: Integrates API to automatically skip sponsored segments, intros, outros, and subscription reminders.
Remove Background Playback Restrictions: Keeps audio running when the screen is locked or while switching apps.
Remove Viewer Discretion Dialog: Bypasses or auto-accepts age-restriction and warning popups.
Add to Queue: Replicates the Premium queuing feature, allowing dynamic video stacking.
Swipe Controls: Enables volume and brightness adjustments by swiping vertically on the player.
Alternative Thumbnails: Integrates DeArrow API to swap clickbait thumbnails for clean, representative stills.
Return YouTube Dislike: Restores the public dislike counter using community database extensions.
Custom Playback Speed: Adds granular speed modifiers (e.g., 0.25x intervals) to the standard selection panel.
External Downloads: Hooks download action items to external engines for offline local storage.
Hide Shorts Components: Completely hides the Shorts tab, navigation shelf, or associated feed widgets.
Theme Customization: Implements custom background colors, deep AMOLED blacks, and Material You dynamic color pallets.
Header & Branding Modifications: Standardizes options to modify the native application title text, banner asset, or app launcher icon.
Change Start Page: Directs default landing routes to custom endpoints such as Subscriptions or Library layouts.
Hide Flyout Menu Components: Trims non-essential options like "Cast", "Report", "Remix", or "Clip" from player menus.
GmsCore Support: Manages routing variables via MicroG/GmsCore for valid Google Account authorization on non-rooted configurations.
Sanitize Sharing Links: Scrubs query trackers, strings, and affiliate tags automatically prior to clipboard copy events.
Disable Video Codecs: Toggles specific codec layers (VP9, AV1, HDR profiles) to optimize efficiency or avoid hardware decoding failure.
Disable QUIC Protocol: Forces fallback standard TCP paths to remedy infinite buffering or stream stalling behaviors.
